tool_usage.rule: Open at most three search results per query before refining the query.
tool_usage.rationale: Reading many results wastes the browsing budget.

tool_usage.rule: Pass absolute file paths to the file reader tool.
tool_usage.rationale: Relative paths resolve against an unknown directory.

tool_usage.rule: Batch independent web requests into one tool call when the tool supports it.

data_validation.rule: Check that a downloaded file is not empty before parsing it.
data_validation.rationale: Empty downloads cause confusing parser errors.

data_validation.rule: Confirm the date of a web page before citing it as current.
Verify that a scraped table has the expected number of columns.

error_handling.rule: On an HTTP 429 response, wait before retrying the same request.
If a page fails to load, try its archived copy.
When a file is not found, list the directory before guessing another name.

efficiency.rule: Cache pages already fetched in this task instead of fetching them again.
Stop browsing once two independent sources agree.
efficiency.rationale: Further sources rarely change the answer.

efficiency.rule: Prefer an official API over scraping when both are available.

analysis_methodology.rule: Cross-check a surprising claim against a second independent source.
Record the URL of every fact used in the answer.
Separate facts found on pages from inferences drawn from them.

safety.rule: Do not submit web forms or make purchases on behalf of the user.
Do not include personal data found on web pages in the answer.
safety.rationale: Personal data must not be spread.

general.rule: Summarize long web pages before quoting from them.

general.rationale: Users want to know the sources.

general.rule: Keep notes of visited pages in the scratchpad.
